content: T2HELIX PUBLICLY SHIPPABLE — 2026-05-11. Three commits landed on main closing the priority list: 1824280 (README: install section, data dir, full v0.0.4 surface), a13b55b (.claude-plugin manifests merged from dogfood/mac-studio-cold-seat), b73a651 (test count + server version). Install path now live: nvm use 22 → claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/templetwo/t2helix → claude plugin install t2helix. Node v26 gets a legible error instead of a gyp wall. Cold-seat dogfood on Mac Studio confirmed 44/44 smoke tests, zero setup friction at runtime — friction was all install surface, now addressed. README reflects full v0.0.4 surface for the first time. Remaining open: WITNESS path empirically unverified, recall() FTS5 on real corpus (insights table empty throughout dogfood), robustness gaps in record()/catch blocks, chronicle.js refactor — all v0.1 territory. Work done across three seats: MacBook (built v0.0.4), Mac Studio (cold-seat dogfood), iPhone Claude (terrain map + sequencing).
